members.name: fund-manager
members.title: Fund Manager
members.duty: Runs the desk day to day: takes an instruction, arranges the macro brief and each pod's research, follows it to completion, and returns one short report plus anything that needs a decision.
members.state_msg: Folding the pods' conclusions into today's report

members.name: macro-strategist
members.title: Macro Strategist
members.duty: Calls the market environment before the open and suggests each pod's posture across index, volatility, rates, gold and oil -- never a single name.

members.name: desk-manager
members.title: Desk Manager
members.duty: Runs research across the sector pods, tracks their progress, and folds their conclusions into a one-page brief ranked by conviction and payoff.
members.state_msg: Both pods in; writing the one-page brief

members.name: risk-pod
members.title: Portfolio Risk
members.duty: Portfolio-level risk: measures exposure, concentration and tail risk from the pods' conclusions and the live book, and flags what needs a hedge. Flags risk; never recommends a trade.
members.state_msg: Waiting on the pods before starting

members.name: trader
members.title: Trader
members.duty: Places the orders once they are approved.

members.name: scrum-master
members.title: Scrum Master
members.duty: Runs the standup and the post-close review, and keeps the team's delivery cadence honest.

members.name: line-manager · example-megacap
members.title: Line Manager
members.duty: Owns the example-megacap pod (AAPL MSFT): has the analysts research each name, chairs the bull and bear debate and the risk review, and delivers the pod's conclusion on every ticker.

members.name: line-manager · example-energy
members.title: Line Manager
members.duty: Owns the example-energy pod (XOM CVX): has the analysts research each name, chairs the bull and bear debate and the risk review, and delivers the pod's conclusion on every ticker.
